help.howitworks.switching_service_source.backTranslation: Why the choices change: sources that failed permanently, services that are disabled, unavailable, out of quota or not included in your plan, or downloads that are already finished will disappear from the list or be shown as unavailable. Switching back and forth does not by itself remove a choice.

Progress: if choosing a source would discard progress already made, DebridPulse first asks Discard download progress?. A service switch that would discard progress is instead refused, with the reason would discard already downloaded data; switch the source to confirm.

While a download is paused: choosing another source for a file that has already started downloading is accepted and saved, but nothing starts. The service and source shown remain the current ones, and next to the service name a message says where the file will be moved, for example Switched to Real-Debrid (rapidgator.net) on resume. Choosing again replaces it; choosing the source currently in use removes the message. After you resume the download, the message reads Switching to … until the switch takes effect, then disappears. If the paused files in a download would be moved to different places, or the destination is unknown, no destination is shown. A file that has never started has nothing to hand over, so its new source takes effect directly when that file starts. Choosing a service while paused works as described above, except that the download stays paused: a service that can take the link currently in use takes over directly (its badge shows this), while a service that must first prepare a copy shows Preparing … and only takes over after you resume the download. These messages appear on the download Activity and Downloads rows; both kinds of message can appear at the same time.

help.howitworks.backup_torrents.each_deb.backTranslation: Each debrid service has a Prepare alternative torrent switch. It is on by default for AllDebrid, Debrid-Link, Premiumize and Real-Debrid, and off by default for TorBox, whose torrent limits are stricter. While the switch is on, that service also adds torrents that another service is currently delivering, so it is ready to take over if needed, and when you switch a download to another service, the torrent it already started is kept as an alternative instead of being deleted. This uses that account's torrent slots and limits; a new download that needs a slot takes it back first. Turn this switch off to keep that service's slots for its own downloads: its alternative torrents are then deleted. Choices you have already saved are kept.

help.settings.users_access.user_accounts.backTranslation: User accounts shows every person with their role, how they sign in, and whether the account is active. Add local account creates an account with a username and password. A role changed in Edit user takes effect immediately: the page that person has open reloads with the new role, without signing them out of the session. Every person has a DebridPulse username, separate from their display name: OIDC accounts take it from their first sign-in, and this name is the one used to sign in with a local password; the pencil icon beside it in the Edit user title changes it and keeps the saved password. Click an account's name to see its details and activity; there, still-pending requests can be withdrawn one by one. Disable and Remove first show how many pending download requests the account has; those requests are withdrawn, transfers that other people also requested keep running, and downloads that have already finished are never touched. Disabling also ends the account's sign-in sessions and stops its tokens; removing an account keeps the account's history and deletes its own notification settings. An OIDC sign-in that was removed and then comes back gets a new account that stays disabled until you enable it. Merge combines two or more accounts into the account you choose to keep; two accounts that share a verified email are flagged, but only Merge combines them. DebridPulse always keeps at least one usable Admin, and you cannot change your own role or disable your own account.

help.topic.delivery_profiles.jobs_files..backTranslation: Submitting a job creates a download request owned by that application. Deleting the job in the application withdraws that request, or confirms receipt of the delivery if it is already finished; the transfer itself only stops if no other party needs it.
Finished files are shared in place: nothing is copied, linked or moved for the application, and neither acknowledgement of receipt nor expiry of a delivery deletes any file.

help.topic.event_logging.principal_contr.backTranslation: Recorded events is the number of events currently stored. Events are kept indefinitely; only a database reset clears them.

findings.resolution: The translator chose the wording recorded in the note.

help.topic.backups.backups.while_enable.backTranslation: While Enable is on, a backup is made every Backup interval, and Run backup makes a backup now. Backups shows the list of saved backups, and lets you add, save, restore or delete one of them.

findings.note: Translator: “Backups” as the list control = Cadangan (backups.title); the list's Remove = Hapus following UI backups.remove/backups.instruction.
findings.resolution: The translator chose the wording recorded in the note.

help.topic.backups.backups.backup.backTranslation: A backup is deleted as soon as its age exceeds Backup retention or it is no longer among the newest backups numbering Maximum number of backups kept, whichever happens first.

findings.resolution: Rephrased: “di antara cadangan terbaru sebanyak <label>”; deletion condition unchanged.

help.topic.backups.backups.older_backups.backTranslation: Old backups are deleted by the saved retention rule, which still applies; its settings are part of the Advanced display mode.

help.topic.backups.statistics_snapshots..backTranslation: Separately, DebridPulse saves a record of the previous 24 hours of activity every Statistics snapshot interval, inside its own database, and deletes snapshots older than Statistics snapshot retention. 0 stops new snapshots from being made.

help.topic.database_reset.intro.erases_d.backTranslation: Deletes DebridPulse's download history so it starts empty. Use it only if you really intend to start over.

help.topic.database_reset.what_removed_k.backTranslation: Deleted: transfers with their file records, download requests, external tasks, events and the Activity log, and statistics snapshots.
Kept: accounts, passwords, OpenID Connect links, API tokens, personal notification settings, and every setting. Files already downloaded on disk are not deleted.

help.topic.database_reset.safeguards.res.backTranslation: Reset database only works while Allow database reset is on, and asks you to confirm.

help.topic.database_reset.safeguards.pro.backTranslation: Processing is paused during the reset and returns to its previous status afterwards. A safety backup is made first; if it fails, nothing is deleted.
